title: 690 WORLD CUP MINUTES, NOT ONE CARD. THEN CAME THE COACHING CV
description:
Five clean sheets, two goals conceded. Then the dugout happened.

Fabio Cannavaro played all 690 minutes of the 2006 World Cup without a single card. Five clean sheets, two goals conceded. A wall, basically.

The coaching CV is a different read. Benevento: 17 games, three wins, seven draws, seven defeats. Very balanced. Then the sack. Dinamo Zagreb: 14 games. Udinese: six, and he wasn't kept. Seventeen, fourteen, six. A countdown.

He once told Ronaldo to keep playing a few more years, right after Ronaldo scored twice against him. Fair enough, he had the evidence. And he's only the third defender to win the Ballon d'Or, after Beckenbauer and Sammer.

Both things are true: 17 games at Benevento, 690 minutes without a card. Only one of them is on the wall.

Does the coaching CV change how you remember him as a player? Tell us why.
